rationale:
The subject `requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.ValidationContext.read_source` has three obligations. It must resolve an outline item to its graph node. It must read the contents. It must record the observation as described by the cited `read_source.inputs`. The marked test `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs#mod[tests]/fn[direct_source_reads_preserve_mapping_errors_and_record_only_successful_returns]` covers each of them.

- **Resolve.** The test uses an unmapped file (`unknown.txt`) and an unmapped selector (`line[unknown]`). Both must fail with the 'unsupported source item' error. Each case asserts that `dependencies()` is empty. After both, it asserts that the domain performed no reads (`reads == 0`) and recorded no read nodes. A successful read of `source.txt` reads exactly `source-node`, shown by `read_nodes == ["source-node", "source-node"]`.
- **Read.** With `fail_read` set, `read_source` returns the domain's 'prepared source read failed' error. Nothing is recorded. With the failure cleared, the call returns the contents, and the test asserts `returned.format() == "prepared contents"`.
- **Record.** After the success, `dependencies()` equals exactly `[Dependency::Node(source-node, returned.fingerprint())]`. This checks the node identity, the fingerprint of the supplied contents, and that only one dependency is recorded. That means the earlier failures recorded nothing, which matches 'Failures record no successful observation'.
- **Staleness.** The test finishes the record. It asserts the record is current. It then changes the domain text and asserts the record is no longer current. This matches 'stale when that node's fingerprint changes'.

The `read_source.inputs` text on agent reads delivering contents, and on the standalone outline parser, concerns other items. It is cited context and not an obligation of this subject.

`crates/trust-but-verify/tests/public_api.rs#fn[public_exports_match_the_appendix]` is a marked export-inventory test. It is not relevant to behavior here. It does not affect adequacy.

I found no gap.

text: Resolve an outline item to its graph node, read the contents, and record the observation under {cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.read_source.inputs`.
impl<D: Domain> ValidationContext<'_, D> where D::Error: From<SourceError> {
A successful source read records the mapped node's identity and the fingerprint
record when returning the contents; agent reads record when delivering them.
The dependency becomes stale when that node's fingerprint changes. The source
mapping cannot return an untracked successful read. Calling the standalone
outline parser directly records no graph dependency; a tracked node read must
enclose its use when its contents contribute to an assessment.
